responsibility: This file implements mc’s temporary fragment-file combiner. It creates numbered per-fragment files, remembers them in an indexed table and cleanup list, copies their contents sequentially into a designated destination file, and removes the temporary files afterward. It is an output-assembly helper for generated code emission rather than part of lexing or semantic analysis.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the working implementation of the mcStream stem, creating /tmp fragment files, tracking them in indexes/lists, copying bytes into the destination, and unlinking temporaries; mcStream.def only declares those operations.
